name: Shibecha (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shibecha town emblem in green: a crescent with its points upward.
history: Municipal flag of Shibecha, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 June 1968.

features.role: Shibecha town emblem — a crescent with its points upward
